construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.
Building application pending review on the city's list.

Approval of 2026-05-20 (Community Development Director, ministerial): APN 406-06-098, General Plan Neighborhood Commercial Mixed-Use (18-25 du/gr. acre), zoning NC-MU, form-based zone T4N.M, San Tomas Area Neighborhood Plan; applicant Alignment Architects INC., property owner STORYRD LLC; CEQA exempt per 15268; density 27.27 du/acre; units approximately 38 feet 3 inches tall; approval valid until May 20, 2028.

The approval letter states the project was submitted under preliminary application PLN-2025-103 filed July 25, 2025; the city's permit data lists the preliminary application as PLN-2025-109, created 2025-07-24.
The approval states a transformer on this site is proposed to serve the adjoining development at 900 S. San Tomas Aquino Road, with an easement for that property.

The 2025 project description and tenancy affidavit list APNs 406-060-93, 406-060-07 and 406-060-09; the affidavit covers 900 & 920 S San Tomas Aquino Rd and 1200-1204 Smith Ave, states Eunjoo Beak owned the property until its sale to Chun Yi (6A Holdings LLC), owner since 07.17.2024, and states the Smith Ave house was rented for about a year in 2018-2019 and unoccupied since.

Building application BLD-2026-1231 (applicant Storyrd LLC, pending review): six 3-story townhouses under SB 1123 with 0 affordable units; five units with 3 bedrooms, 3 baths and 2-car garage, one unit with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths and 2-car garage.

Project description 2025-08-07: two 4-bedroom units (2,359 and 2,345 sq ft) and four 3-bedroom units (2,039 sq ft), each with 2-car garage, total floor area 12,860 sq ft, 3 stories (30 ft 5 in grade-to-eave, 36 ft 11 in roof pitch); about 18 months of construction.

City Starter Home Projects page (updated 11/19/2026): PLN-2025-114, submitted 08/07/2025, 6 units, Mixed-Use zoning, status Approved. City planning data lists PLN-2025-114 as Project Closed (updated 2026-10-23).
